tasks.name: World Bible
tasks.objective: Produce the World Bible for this project, meeting every acceptance criterion, then submit it for Studio Director review.
acceptance: Regions and biomes listed with gameplay purpose for each
Landmark and point-of-interest budget stated in numbers
World history and faction context that explains the current state
Scale and traversal times consistent with the movement budget

tasks.name: World Layout and Biome Table
tasks.objective: Produce the World Layout and Biome Table for this project, meeting every acceptance criterion, then submit it for Studio Director review.
acceptance: Playable-space map or schematic with coordinates or grid
Per-biome palette, prop set and density targets
Hand-authored versus generated areas explicitly divided

tasks.name: World Consistency Review
tasks.objective: Produce the World Consistency Review for this project, meeting every acceptance criterion, then submit it for Studio Director review.
acceptance: Named locations in the build match the world bible or the bible is updated
Traversal times measured in the build against the stated budget
